routes: /docker (Overview tab): Docker hosts table, status chips, containers table and the container drawer, served by Vite from this working tree against a real backend built from main.
states: Real Docker 29 host with a real Pulse agent, ten running containers, an HTTP availability check attached to each published web port.
Before the failure: every container green, chips Healthy 10 and Degraded 0, no State column.

The app inside the svc container killed while the container kept running, after two failed checks: svc row amber, sorted first, State reads Not responding, hover reads 'Running, but its availability check is failing: svc:8095', chips Healthy 9 and Degraded 1, alerts badge 1.
Container drawer for svc: the Availability card shows the check as Down with its target and error.
After the container was restarted and the check passed: svc back to Running, default order, chips Healthy 10 and Degraded 0.
interactions: Degraded chip filtered the table to the one not-responding container.
Expand details opened the svc drawer and its Availability card.
At 375 px: Not responding sits beside the container name, rows stay 32 px high like their neighbours, no horizontal overflow.
At 1280 px every container row measured 33 px high with the State column shown.
limits: One Docker host on a lab rig; Podman and multi-host pages were not exercised.
Light theme was not re-checked for this change, which adds no new colour: it reuses the existing warning tone.
